score_and_selection.primary_endpoint: log2(corrected 6TG count-table frequency / corrected mock count-table frequency)
score_and_selection.raw_source_nonzero_rule: raw P0, mock, and 6-TG counts >0 in both source replicates; prevents the 0.9 WT correction floor alone from qualifying a source variant
score_and_selection.group_rule: at least two distinct DNA keys after source-only eligibility
score_and_selection.WT_error_correction: sample count minus mutation-specific WT_plasmid count scaled by same-tile sample/WT count-table total; negative adjusted counts set to 0.9
score_and_selection.WT_correction_scope: shared WT_plasmid reference, conditional reconstruction; not a causal/biological isolation
score_and_selection.denominator: sum of deposited count-table rows within tile, including the tile WT row; not a raw sequencer read total
score_and_selection.WT_denominator: sum of WT_plasmid counts in the same tile block and deposited row universe

validation.outer: leave one of three culture replicates out; source eligibility from the other two
validation.source_beta: cross-replicate within-AA residual covariance / source residual variance, clipped to [0,1], fit outside each validation-position fold
validation.baseline: same-budget mean of two source replicate AA group means
validation.weighting: AA groups equally weighted; DNA variants equally weighted within group
validation.inference_limit: conditional within-study position uncertainty; three held-replicate rounds are overlapping internal transfer, not independent external validation

tile_layout_and_denominator.tile_assignment: contiguous rows after TileXX_nt_wt through the next tile marker
tile_layout_and_denominator.denominator_definition: sum of deposited count-table rows within tile, including the tile WT row; not a raw sequencer read total
tile_layout_and_denominator.wt_denominator_definition: sum of WT_plasmid counts in the same tile block and deposited row universe
